from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import requests
import json

def get_product_info(html):
    soup = BeautifulSoup(html, 'lxml')
    products = []
    for article in soup.find_all('article', {'class': 'product_pod'}):
        product = {}
        product['name'] = article.h3.a.text.strip()
        product['price'] = float(article.select('.price_color')[0].text[1:])
        products.append(product)
    return products

def get_products(url):
    response = requests.get(url)
    if response.status_code == 200:
        html = response.content
        products = get_product_info(html)
        return products
    else:
        print("Request failed with status code", response.status_code)
        return None

def main():
    url = "https://books.toscrape.com/catalogue/category/books_1/page-4.html"
    products = get_products(url)
    print(json.dumps(products, indent=4))

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

def extract_products(html):
    products = []
    soup = BeautifulSoup(html, 'html.parser')
    product_list = soup.find('ol', {'class': 'row'})
    for li in product_list:
        product = {}
        image_container = li.find('div', {'class': 'image_container'})
        img = image_container.find('img')
        product['image'] = img.attrs['src'] if img else None
        product_details = li.find('div', {'class': 'product_details'})
        h3 = product_details.find('h3').text.strip()
        product['name'] = h3
        price = product_details.find('p', {'class': 'price_color'}).text.strip()
        product['price'] = float(price[1:])
        products.append(product)
    return products
[/PYTHON]

from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import requests
import re
import json

def get_product_info(soup):
    product_name = soup.find("h1").text.strip()
    price = soup.find(class_="price_color").text
    return {"product_name": product_name, "price": price}

def get_all_products(page_source):
    soup = BeautifulSoup(page_source, "html.parser")
    products = []
    for article in soup.find_all("article", class_="product_pod"):
        product_info = get_product_info(article)
        products.append(product_info)
    return products

def scrape_data(url):
    response = requests.get(url)
    page_source = response.text
    all_products = get_all_products(page_source)
    return json.dumps(all_products, indent=4)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    url = "https://books.toscrape.com/catalogue/category/books_1/index.html"
    data = scrape_data(url)
    print(data)

import json

def extract_products(html):
    data = []
    # Use a HTML parser to parse the HTML content
    soup = BeautifulSoup(html, 'html.parser')
    # Find all the product containers on the page
    products = soup.find_all('article', {'class': 'product_pod'})
    for product in products:
        # Extract the name and price of the product
        name = product.h3.a['title']
        price = product.find('p', {'class': 'price_color'}).text
        # Add the product to the list of results
        data.append({'product_name': name, 'price': price})
    return data
